title: Whales: Can they be saved?
creator_credit: Kenneth Post, Alan P. Sloan and Reid-Cowan Productions
brief_description: Shows a variety of species within the two major branches of the whale family: the baleen and the toothed whales. Describes their characteristics and behaviour. Because modern whaling is so efficient many whales are in danger of extinction.
